items.action: Delete every `[dsSubmitted]` binding, remove `SubmittedDirective` from component `imports`, and remove any `DS_SUBMITTED` provider. Validation errors show once a field is touched, with no flag.
items.appliesWhen: Code written against 1.0.0 that uses `[dsSubmitted]`, `SubmittedDirective` or `DS_SUBMITTED`. Code upgrading from 0.15 has none of them.
items.verify: No `dsSubmitted`, `SubmittedDirective` or `DS_SUBMITTED` remains, and an invalid field shows its error after it is left.

informational: Validation errors of a DS field bound to a form model show once the field is touched, and the unparseable-date error of `ds-date-picker` shows on blur. `[touched]` is an input of every DS field.
